sections.title: Day 34 學習概覽
sections.markdown:
- 辨識 Only when、Under no circumstances 等否定倒裝

sections.title: ② 今日文法｜Only when/after、Under no circumstances、假設倒裝、主詞一致與條件連接詞
sections.markdown:
主題：**Only when/after、Under no circumstances、假設倒裝、主詞一致與條件連接詞**

### 規則 1

`Only after/when + clause + auxiliary + subject + base verb`

> Only after the figures were verified did the team publish the report.

Only after/when 引導的限制片語置於句首時，主要子句倒裝；did 後使用原形 publish。

### 規則 2

`Under no circumstances + modal/auxiliary + subject + verb`

> Under no circumstances should staff share their passwords.

否定限制片語放句首，使用助動詞或情態動詞倒裝。

### 規則 3

`Had it not been for + noun, S + would have + past participle`

> Had it not been for the backup system, the meeting would have been canceled.

過去相反假設；表示若當時沒有某項支援，結果本會不同。

### 規則 4

`Were + subject + to + base verb, main clause with would/could`

> Were the shipment to arrive late, we would contact the customer.

省略 if 的正式假設句，表示較不確定的未來情況。

### 規則 5

`Neither A nor B + verb agreeing with nearest subject`

> Neither the director nor the assistants are available.

neither...nor 連接主詞時，通常依靠近動詞的主詞決定單複數。

### 規則 6

`unless / provided that / even if`

> We will confirm the booking provided that the budget is approved.

unless=除非；provided that=只要；even if=即使，需區分必要條件與讓步。

sections.title: 03 Listening｜Portal Rollout and Conditional Approval
sections.markdown:
先播放 transcript 的 TTS，不看文字作答；提交後才顯示逐字稿與解析。

聽力稿：

> Man: Can we tell the branch managers that the new portal will be available to everyone on Monday?
> Woman: Installation is finished, but the security team has not approved the access controls. Their review should be complete Friday afternoon. If they sign off, we can start a twenty-person pilot on Monday. The companywide rollout is scheduled for Wednesday.
> Man: So a full Monday launch is out of the question?
> Woman: At this stage, yes. The pilot is still possible, provided that we get approval.
> Man: I will send an updated schedule once the review is finished.

sections.title: 04 Listening｜Accessible Training Room Selection
sections.markdown:
先播放 transcript 的 TTS，不看文字作答；提交後才顯示逐字稿與解析。

聽力稿：

> Woman: We need a training room for thirty-two people on Tuesday from nine until noon. It must have wheelchair access and a projector, and our total limit is five hundred twenty dollars.
> Man: Beacon is inexpensive, but it has no accessible entrance. Cobalt has one, though the projector adds eighty-five dollars to its four-hundred-sixty-dollar price.
> Woman: Dune looks promising.
> Man: It is available only in the afternoon. Aster holds thirty-five, has an accessible entrance, and includes the projector for four hundred ninety-five dollars.
> Woman: Then please place a tentative booking for Aster and send me the confirmation.

sections.title: ⑥ Reading｜BrightLine Event Catering: Discount Threshold and Outage Exception
sections.markdown:
限時：**8 分 30 秒**。

### BrightLine Event Services — Venue and Catering Terms

> For the November 20 workshop, Hall A holds up to 40 people and costs $420; its projector is included. Hall B holds up to 28 people and costs $350, with an additional $60 projector charge. Catering costs $22 per ordered meal. Orders of at least 30 meals receive a 10% discount on the catering subtotal only; room rental and the $80 setup fee are not discounted. Discount eligibility depends on the number of meals ordered, not the number of people who attend. Unused meals are nonrefundable. Meal quantities may normally be changed without an administrative fee through November 14. Changes after that date incur a $40 administrative fee.

用途：General prices, discount rules and deadlines

### Oakridge Training — Booking #B214

> On November 10, Oakridge booked Hall A for November 20, with 32 expected attendees, 32 catered meals, and the included projector. The total event budget is $1,150, including setup. On November 13, three attendees canceled, leaving 29 expected participants. The organizer is considering reducing the meal order from 32 to 29, but has not yet confirmed any change.

用途：Initial order and revised attendance

### BrightLine Notice — Portal Outage Exception

> Because our booking portal was unavailable on the afternoon of November 14, Booking #B214 may confirm a revised meal quantity through November 15 without the usual $40 administrative fee. You may order 30 meals even if only 29 people are expected; the 10% catering discount applies because the order contains 30 meals. If you order 29 meals, the discount does not apply. Hall A remains reserved and the $420 room rental and $80 setup fee are unchanged. We will not adjust the meal quantity automatically. Please reply with your final quantity by November 15.

用途：Updated deadline and quantity option

### 計算提示
- `32 meals: 32×22×0.9 + 420 + 80 = 1133.60`
- `29 meals: 29×22 + 420 + 80 = 1138.00 (discount lost)`
- `30 meals: 30×22×0.9 + 420 + 80 = 1094.00`
- `Savings of 30 meals vs 29 meals = 44.00; 30-meal budget margin = 56.00`
- `For booking B214, no-fee change deadline extended from Nov 14 to Nov 15; no automatic adjustment.`

sections.title: ⑨ 複習與錯題分類
sections.markdown:
回顧前 **[29, 30, 31, 32, 33] 天**，完成 **[{'prompt': 'Hardly _____ the meeting begun when the alarm rang.', 'answer': 'had', 'tag': 'G'}, {'prompt': 'Not only _____ the vendor reduce the price, but it also extended the warranty.', 'answer': 'did', 'tag': 'G'}, {'prompt': 'Should you _____ assistance, contact support.', 'answer': 'require', 'tag': 'G'}, {'prompt': 'Had we known, we _____ changed suppliers.', 'answer': 'would have', 'tag': 'G'}, {'prompt': 'The number of requests _____ decreased.', 'answer': 'has', 'tag': 'AGR'}, {'prompt': 'A number of customers _____ complained.', 'answer': 'have', 'tag': 'AGR'}, {'prompt': 'The director requested that the form _____ revised.', 'answer': 'be', 'tag': 'G'}, {'prompt': 'Not necessarily = ?', 'answer': '不一定；仍有可能', 'tag': 'IMP'}, {'prompt': 'Supersede an earlier policy = ?', 'answer': '取代先前政策', 'tag': 'U'}, {'prompt': '$310 + $70 = ?', 'answer': '$380', 'tag': 'CAL'}, {'prompt': '$280 − $250 = ?', 'answer': '$30', 'tag': 'CAL'}, {'prompt': 'in case 與 provided that 的差別？', 'answer': 'in case=以防；provided that=只要', 'tag': 'C'}] 張**複習卡。

先遮住答案，90 秒回想；將錯誤標籤回填今日錯題記錄。

錯題標籤：

- `G`：Grammar 文法
- `V`：Vocabulary 字彙
- `L`：Listening 聽力理解
- `P`：Paraphrase 同義改寫
- `I`：Information Integration 資訊整合
- `T`：Timeline 時間順序
- `E`：Exception 特殊例外
- `U`：Updated Information 更新資訊
- `C`：Condition 條件判斷
- `N`：Next Action 下一步
- `POS`：Part of Speech 詞性
- `INT`：Intent 意圖
- `CAL`：Calculation 計算
- `SEQ`：Sequence 步驟順序
- `AGR`：Subject–Verb Agreement 主詞動詞一致
- `IMP`：Implication 隱含意圖
- `BUD`：Budget Constraint 預算限制

questions.prompt: Only after the audit was completed _____ the company release its findings.
questions.explanation: Only after 置句首，主句過去式倒裝 did + S + release。

questions.prompt: Under no circumstances _____ confidential files be sent to personal email accounts.
questions.explanation: Under no circumstances + should + S + be sent。

questions.prompt: Had it not been for the backup server, the service _____ unavailable all morning.
questions.explanation: 過去相反假設：would have + p.p.。

questions.prompt: Were the shipment to arrive late, we _____ the customer immediately.
questions.explanation: Were ... to + V 表示假設，主句用 would + V。

questions.prompt: Neither the project leader nor the technicians _____ responsible for the installation.
questions.explanation: 靠近動詞的 technicians 是複數。

questions.prompt: The report, along with the supporting charts, _____ ready for review.
questions.explanation: 真正主詞 report 是單數。

questions.prompt: The reservation will be confirmed _____ the deposit is received.
questions.explanation: provided that 表示必要條件。

questions.prompt: Please keep the printed schedule _____ the network becomes unavailable.
questions.explanation: in case 表示預防。

questions.prompt: The documents _____ by the legal department were sent yesterday.
questions.explanation: documents 與 review 為被動關係，使用過去分詞。

questions.prompt: The revised proposal was submitted two days _____ the stated deadline.
questions.explanation: ahead of the deadline = 提前於截止期限。

questions.prompt: A number of suppliers _____ offered revised quotations.
questions.explanation: A number of + 複數名詞，使用複數動詞 have。

questions.prompt: The number of unresolved tickets _____ fallen this month.
questions.explanation: The number of 作單數主詞。

questions.prompt: The coordinator requested that all attendees _____ notified immediately.
questions.explanation: request that + S + be + p.p.。

questions.prompt: The new guidelines will take effect _____ the director signs the approval form.
questions.explanation: as soon as 引導時間子句，未來事件用現在式 signs。

questions.prompt: Not until the revised invoice arrived _____ Accounting process the payment.
questions.explanation: Not until 句首引導過去事件，主句 did + S + 原形 process。

questions.prompt: Under no circumstances _____ the report be distributed before approval.
questions.explanation: 否定限制片語句首倒裝：Under no circumstances should the report be distributed.

questions.prompt: Only when the final figures were confirmed _____ the team publish the results.
questions.explanation: Only when + 子句，主句過去式倒裝 did + S + publish。

questions.prompt: Had it not been for the backup generator, the presentation _____ canceled.
questions.explanation: 對過去的相反假設使用 would have been。

questions.prompt: Neither the coordinator nor the assistants _____ responsible for the delay.
questions.explanation: 靠近動詞的 assistants 是複數。
